subject: Vendor registration + invoice PO split / VAT reconciliation for upcoming order
messages:
From: Alana Perez <ap@horizonhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Martin O'Neill <martin.oneill@horizonhealth.com>, Horizon Health Procurement <purchasing@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jan 2028 09:13:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor registration + PO split requirements for PO-48932

Hi Vanessa,

Hope you're well — Horizon is moving forward with PO-48932 for the pilot deployment. AP has a couple of setup items we need to complete before we can schedule payment runs. Can you confirm the following and send the items listed below?

1) Supplier portal registration: please register Redwood in our supplier portal (link below) so we can attach supplier records to the PO. We need a primary contact and remit details during registration.

2) Invoice line-item mapping: the PO will be issued with three cost lines (Infra, Support, Professional Services). Our AR requires that submitted invoices map each invoice line to the PO line number exactly and include our internal SKU in the invoice "Item Description" field. If invoices do not map 1:1 to PO lines we will return for correction.

3) VAT / tax treatment: Horizon is in the EU/US mix and we need to know if Redwood will send invoices with VAT or with a reverse-charge note. If you are EU-registered please attach VAT certificate; if US-only, send W-9.

4) Bank mandate: for ACH/wire we require a signed bank mandate (DocuSign link acceptable) to allow payment creation.

Can you send the vendor packet and confirm you can provide PO-line mapping on the invoice (we prefer a dedicated "PO Line" column)? We'd like all items onboarded by next Wednesday so finance can process the first invoice in the February run.

Thanks — attaching our PO template for your reference.

Attachments: Horizon_PO_Template.xlsx
Links: https://supplier.horizonhealth.com/portal/invite/7a8f

Cheers,
Alana Perez
Accounts Payable
Horizon Health
ap@horizonhealth.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 22 Jan 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor registration + PO split requirements for PO-48932

Hi Alana — thanks for the clear checklist. Attached is our Redwood AP packet and a current W-9. Quick answers up front:

- Supplier portal: we'll register today using the link and set Vanessa Ortiz as primary contact (vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com; +1 415-555-0173).
- PO line mapping: we can include a dedicated "PO Line" column in each invoice and will include your PO item SKU under "Item Description". We will ensure a 1:1 mapping for the three lines you described.
- VAT: Redwood is US-headquartered but we have an EU VAT registration for our Dublin entity. We will provide the EU VAT certificate and indicate "Reverse charge — Article 194" on invoices where applicable.
- Bank mandate: we'll sign the DocuSign bank mandate and upload the signed copy to your portal.

Attached: Redwood_AP_Packet.xlsx, Redwood_W9.pdf
DocuSign bank mandate: https://docusign.net/RedwoodBankMandate/XYZ123

Action plan: I will: register in your portal today; upload packet + W-9; share the EU VAT cert once I confirm with finance; and update our invoice template so every line includes "PO Line" and "Horizon SKU" fields. If you have a preferred invoice PDF template we can submit against your exact layout — otherwise we'll use the attached example that follows your PO template.

Let me know if Horizon requires any additional fields (cost-center, tax-code) on the invoice line.

Best,

Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Ops — Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0173

Vanessa — quick follow on VAT: Horizon will apply reverse-charge where Horizon is the VAT debtor. We need Redwood to:

- Provide EU VAT registration number and certificate if you want to invoice with VAT zero-rated, or
- Mark invoices with a reverse-charge note and show VAT as 0.00 with the reference to the applicable directive.

Also, for multi-line POs we prefer each invoice line to include three mandatory fields: PO Number, PO Line Number, Horizon SKU. If Redwood cannot produce machine-readable CSV/Excel exports for invoice ingestion, let us know — we may need to import via a small mapping file.

Thanks,
Martin
Senior Procurement Manager
Horizon Health
